title: What If Every Fungus on Earth Vanished?
description:
If all fungi disappeared, what would happen to plants and forests?

Sources:
- NOAA: https://www.noaa.gov/science
- National Institutes of Health: https://www.nih.gov/research-training
- NIST: https://www.nist.gov/topics/physics
- U.S. Geological Survey: https://www.usgs.gov/science

Illustrative visuals are labelled. Speculative outcomes are not presented as measured fact.

Impossible Brief · Episode 9 · One impossible scenario, worked through with real science, every day.
